drop: Drop a Word document here to convert it to PDF
privacy: Your document stays in this browser. No uploads or remote content.
invalid: Choose a readable DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file. It may be damaged or use an unsupported feature.
failed: The PDF could not be created. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This document contains missing or unsupported content. No incomplete PDF was created.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources to render this document. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page or try a current browser.
fidelity: Supported content is rendered as image pages at 150 DPI, using the document’s page sizes and orientation. The page count follows the browser’s layout.
limitations: Text is not selectable and OCR is not added. The final document view is used; review comments are omitted and page or date fields may update. Macros, interactive fields, links, and digital signatures are not preserved or verified.
protected: Password-protected Word files are not supported. Save an unencrypted copy in your Office application and try again.
layoutNotice: Fonts and pagination may differ from Word. Check the page breaks, text, tables, images, and field values in the preview before downloading.
